abstract: Maintains heavy surface access routing records and transport vehicle fleet specifications
system_message:
You are Hazardous cold-chain logistics coordinator (TRN). You serve as the Hazardous cold-chain logistics coordinator (TRN). In this capacity, you maintain heavy surface access routing records and transport vehicle fleet specifications, including monitoring access corridor clearance widths and cryogenic trailer escort readiness.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains heavy surface access routing records and transport vehicle fleet specifications（LOGS）
information_points.content:
TRN-LOGS-T1X：For Sub-Alpine Cavern Biorepository, the heavy access corridor road clearance width between the public highway junction and the intake loading dock maintains a minimum paved horizontal clear width of 9.8 m accommodating twin multi-axle lowboy cryogenic tankers.
TRN-LOGS-T4O：For Boreal Bedrock Cryo-Vault, the heavy access corridor road clearance width from the public highway junction to the repository intake loading dock provides a minimum paved horizontal clear width of 6.5 m accommodating twin multi-axle lowboy cryogenic tankers.
TRN-LOGS-TA8：For Permafrost Deep-Strata Repository, the heavy access corridor road clearance width along the route from the public highway junction to the intake loading dock offers a minimum paved horizontal clear width of 8.2 m accommodating twin multi-axle lowboy cryogenic tankers.

information_points.title: Cryogenic trailer escort readiness（FLEET）
information_points.content:
TRN-FLEET-WN7：Regarding cryogenic trailer escort readiness, Boreal Bedrock Cryo-Vault has 10 temperature-controlled dry-shipper transport vehicles registered as active cold-chain transport trucks equipped with onboard GPS and continuous telemetry.
TRN-FLEET-IM6：Regarding cryogenic trailer escort readiness, Sub-Alpine Cavern Biorepository operates 4 temperature-controlled dry-shipper transport vehicles active in its authorized cold-chain fleet with onboard GPS and continuous telemetry.
TRN-FLEET-YC2：Regarding cryogenic trailer escort readiness, Permafrost Deep-Strata Repository maintains 7 temperature-controlled dry-shipper transport vehicles registered as authorized articulated cold-chain transport trucks equipped with onboard GPS and continuous telemetry.
